pcs.pc_description: inspect pool and identify any floating or submerged hazards in the water
inspect the pool liner and foundation for any leaks, cracks, or other damage
check drains, lights, handrails, and ladders to make sure they are properly installed and safely in place
ensure there is no current leakages for electrical components involved in the pool’s functioning like filters, pumps, heaters, etc.
inspect if diving board is properly secured to the deck and has no signs of damage or weakening
check water temperature, pH and chlorine levels as per the standards
ensure that appropriate signage and instructions is displayed on pool site
set up rescue equipment (rings, jackets, poles, rope, etc.) and place within reach
ensure floating aids are available in the pool (floats, kickboards, noodles, balls, etc.)
ensure resuscitation equipment such as oxygen mask, reservoir bag, etc. are available and within reach
stock first aid adequately
ensure personal hygiene
ensure equipment, pool area, common area, etc. are sanitized before and after the usage
guide others about hygiene and sanitation workplace requirements
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority

pcs.pc_description: identify and respond to swimmers with signs of exertion and secondary factors of drowning like intoxication, etc.

identify and report inappropriate behaviour (e.g. sexual harassment) to appropriate authority
